integrity.title: Audit log check
integrity.intro: Each audit log entry carries a hash of the one before, so a changed or removed entry breaks the chain. Termix checks it every hour and alerts every admin when it breaks. Download the newest hash now and then and keep it somewhere else: later you can paste it here to prove nothing before it was rewritten.
integrity.broken: The chain is broken at entry {{id}}
integrity.checked: {{count}} entries checked | {{unchained}} from before the chain | checked {{time}}
integrity.head: Newest entry {{id}} | {{hash}}
integrity.badHead: That is not a saved head. It needs an id and a hash.
integrity.headOk: The saved head matches and nothing after it was changed
integrity.headPruned: That entry was removed by the log's size or age limit, so it can't be compared any more
integrity.headMissing: The saved head does not match. The log was changed or rewritten
integrity.failed: That did not work. Try again.

problem.row_missing: an entry was removed or added
